entries.summary: Security: added CSRF nonce to mu_membership_mark_card_sent AJAX handler and its JS caller
entries.notes: BH-H1: mu_membership_mark_card_sent() had no nonce check, allowing CSRF from any page a logged-in admin visited. Fixed by adding check_ajax_referer('oha_mark_card_sent') to the handler and wp_create_nonce('oha_mark_card_sent') + fd.append('_ajax_nonce', ...) to the inline fetch() in mu_membership_admin_footer_js(). Both sides updated atomically - handler and caller must match.

entries.summary: Security: replaced .html() with .text() in admin.js showNotice() and frontend.js showMessage()
entries.notes:
BH-M1/BH-M2: Both functions used jQuery .html('

' + message + '

') which would execute HTML from server response data.message fields. Replaced with .append($('

').text(message)) so message content is always treated as plain text. Eliminates a latent DOM XSS vector in both admin and frontend contexts.

entries.summary: Security: added CSV injection sanitizer to member export and vendor export
entries.notes: BH-M3: fputcsv() was writing raw database values without protection against formula injection (=, +, -, @, tab, CR prefixes). Added private static sanitize_csv_value() helper to class-oha-members-table.php and an inline $scsv closure to boardhub-admin.php. Applied to all user-controlled string fields (name, email, company, phone, status, address, etc.). Numeric and boolean fields left unchanged. Spreadsheet apps hide the apostrophe prefix; raw parsers see it as plain text.

entries.summary: Security: replaced wildcard usermeta deletes in uninstall.php with explicit key list
entries.notes: BH-M4: uninstall.php deleted ALL usermeta matching stripe_%, billing_%, and shipping_% which would destroy WooCommerce customer billing/shipping data if both plugins were installed. Replaced with $wpdb->delete() per key against an explicit allow-list of keys only this plugin writes: stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id, billing_address_*, oha_membership_*, oha_card_*, oha_stripe_*.

entries.summary: Security: replaced all-$_GET loop in haunt discounts search form with explicit key whitelist
entries.notes: BH-L1: The haunt discounts admin shortcode iterated all $_GET keys and emitted them as hidden form inputs, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary form field names via a crafted URL. Replaced with explicit foreach over ['page','tab','pg'] only. Removed duplicate explicit hidden inputs for page/tab that appeared just below the loop. Visible form fields (q, active, sort) continue to submit naturally.

entries.summary: Security: restricted webhook GET health-check endpoint to manage_options capability
entries.notes: BH-L2: The GET handler on /wp-json/oha/v1/stripe-webhook was publicly accessible via permission_callback => '__return_true', exposing configuration state (endpoint active, secret key configured, webhook secret configured) to unauthenticated users. Changed permission_callback on the GET route to require current_user_can('manage_options'). POST route (Stripe webhooks) is unaffected and still uses '__return_true' with signature verification.

entries.summary: Added bulk activate/deactivate to Haunt Discounts tab in Board Hub admin
entries.notes: oha-haunt-discounts.lib.php: added checkboxes column to admin table, select-all checkbox, and Bulk Set Active / Set Inactive buttons. Added REST endpoint oha/v1/haunt-discounts/bulk-update that accepts {ids:[...], value:'1'|'0'} and calls update_post_meta + oha_discount_activated/deactivated actions for each. Bulk action JS updates the Active checkboxes in place (no page reload) and shows a count notice. The existing single-row inline edit via oha/v1/haunt-discounts/update is unchanged.

entries.summary: Members who registered via UWP oha_member form (form_id=1) but have no uwp_account_type now appear in both admin and frontend member lists with correct address
entries.notes: Root cause: Some legacy oha_member registrants (UWP form_id=1) never had 'uwp_account_type' usermeta set, making them invisible to both the admin OHA_Members_Table::get_members() Part 1 query (INNER JOIN on uwp_account_type) and possibly the SWPM Part 2 query (if not in SWPM table). Fix: Added Part 3 fallback query to both get_members() in class-oha-members-table.php and fetch_members_legacy_raw() in oha-board-hub.lib.php. Part 3 queries WP users with _uwp_register_form_id='1' AND no uwp_account_type set, excluding users already found by Parts 1 and 2 (by WP user ID and email). Address is read directly from usermeta (billing_address_line1 → address_street → boardhub_address_display chain) so it always shows correctly. Part 3 only runs for views that show oha_member records: all, all_paid, new_paid, cards_not_sent. The address fallback chain added in v2.2.12 (boardhub_address_display → billing_address_line1 → address_street etc.) is now fully effective since the user rows actually appear. Files changed: class-oha-members-table.php (Part 3 added to get_members), oha-board-hub.lib.php (Part 3 added to fetch_members_legacy_raw), oha-board-hub-suite.php (version bump).

entries.summary: New members (UsersWP/Stripe) now appear in both admin Membership tab and frontend Board Hub member list
entries.notes: Root causes: (1) Admin render_membership_tab() called render_member_list() which queried wp_swpm_members_tbl — SWPM is removed from the site so the table is empty/absent. Fixed by replacing the call with OHA_Members_Table::render() which queries uwp_account_type usermeta. (2) Frontend fetch_members_legacy_raw() also only queried wp_swpm_members_tbl — new members never appeared. Fixed by extending the function to also query WordPress users with uwp_account_type='oha_member' or 'listing_owner', excluding users already returned by the SWPM query to prevent duplicates. Address data for SWPM rows is augmented from billing_address_line1/city/state/billing_postal_code/billing_country usermeta (written by Stripe webhook) when SWPM address fields are empty. For uwp-source rows the same billing usermeta fields are used directly. Row format stays compatible with render_members_table() (member_id, first_name, last_name, email, membership_level, subscription_starts, address_*, _source). (3) userswp_set_paid_member() in oha-board-hub-suite.php did not set oha_paid_member_since — the date filter in Board Hub used this key to determine 'new' members, so newly upgraded users were invisible in 30-day/90-day/ytd views. Fixed by adding update_user_meta with current_time('mysql') if not already set. (4) Card-sent AJAX action oha_toggle_card_sent was registered inside if(is_convention_enabled()) block so it only fired when Convention Tools were enabled. Moved registration outside the block so it always fires. (5) card-sent AJAX now syncs oha_card_sent usermeta (used by admin panel) and the oha_card_status table (used by frontend) together. Added data-wp-user-id attribute to table buttons so the AJAX knows which WP user to sync. (6) get_card_status() in oha-board-hub.lib.php gained a third fallback: oha_card_sent usermeta — so the card column is consistent whether toggled from admin or frontend. (7) mu_membership_mark_card_sent() in oha-board-hub-suite.php now writes both usermeta AND the oha_card_status table, and stores '1' instead of 'yes' for consistency. (8) Removed dead 'Open Simple Membership' admin link from frontend members tab. Files changed: oha-board-hub-suite.php (version bump, userswp_set_paid_member, mu_membership_mark_card_sent), includes/admin/class-oha-members-table.php (full rewrite — unified SWPM+uwp query, address fallback chain, dual card status read, CSV export), includes/admin/class-oha-admin-page.php (render_membership_tab wired to OHA_Members_Table::render), includes/integrations/oha-board-hub.lib.php (fetch_members_legacy_raw unified, AJAX hook fix, card usermeta sync, data-wp-user-id, dead link removed).

entries.summary: Tab management enable/disable now works correctly on Board Hub frontend
entries.notes: Three bugs were causing disabled tabs to still appear. (1) Unchecked HTML checkboxes submit no data at all — fixed by adding a hidden input with value=0 before each checkbox so the setting is always submitted. (2) PHP (bool)'0' evaluates to true because '0' is a non-empty string — fixed by replacing (bool) cast with filter_var(FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN) in get_all_tabs_ordered() and get_custom_tabs(). (3) Two-loop logic bug: loop 1 correctly skipped disabled tabs but loop 2 then re-added them as fallbacks because they were missing from $all_tabs — fixed by tracking an $explicitly_disabled array in loop 1 and excluding those slugs from the fallback loop. All three fixes are in oha-board-hub.lib.php only.

entries.summary: Dev Log admin menu hidden from Board Hub sidebar, Overview card rebuilt to use OHA Dev Log Aggregator
entries.notes: oha_dev_log CPT show_in_menu set to false — CPT still exists and stores data, aggregator reads it, only sidebar item removed. Both duplicate Recent Activity cards removed from Overview tab. render_overview_widget() replaced with new version that reads from OHA_Dev_Log_Data (aggregator) when installed, falls back to direct CPT query if not. New card shows entry count, estimated hours, type breakdown pills (feature/fix/change/note), and 5 most recent entries. Hour estimates: feature=3h, change=1.5h, fix=1h, note=0.25h.

entries.summary: Baseline — v2.2.8-FINAL-WORKING-STRIPE-SETTINGS was the starting point for this session
entries.notes: File uploaded: oha-board-hub-suite-v2_2_8-FINAL-WORKING-STRIPE-SETTINGS.zip. All Stripe webhook and settings functionality confirmed working at this version.

entries.summary: Added Sponsors tab to board hub shortcode with full CRUD sponsor management
entries.notes: New tab at order 45 between Convention 2026 and Finance. Delegates to [oha_sponsor_hub] shortcode. Added render_sponsors_tab() method and sponsors case in switch to oha-board-hub.lib.php. Tab appears in all board hub instances automatically.

entries.summary: Added [oha_sponsor_hub] shortcode for managing OHA convention sponsors
entries.notes: New file: includes/integrations/oha-sponsor-hub.lib.php. Manages oha_sponsor CPT posts. Two tiers: Convention Sponsor (00 flat) and Water Station (variable). Four statuses: Invited/Paid/In-Kind/Confirmed. Payment methods: stripe/cash/check/in-kind/waived. Logo upload via WP media uploader. Year filter defaults to active_year from oha_sponsor_hub_settings. Copy Link button appends ?client_reference_id=POST_ID to configured Stripe Payment Link. Mark Paid inline panel. CSV export. Summary stats bar.

entries.summary: Added Stripe webhook handler to auto-mark oha_sponsor posts as Paid
entries.notes: Hooks oha_process_webhook_event filter (owned by Board Hub). Intercepts checkout.session.completed only when client_reference_id resolves to an oha_sponsor post. Safely passes membership payments through (WP user IDs are not oha_sponsor post IDs). Stores _oha_status=Paid, _payment_method=stripe, _stripe_session_id, _paid_date, and updates sponsor_amount from session.amount_total.

entries.summary: Webhook: only promote to OHA member for subscription checkouts, not one-time payments
entries.notes: handle_checkout_completed now returns early if session->subscription is empty. Prevents shirt/booth/award buyers from being tagged as oha_member via uwp_account_type.

entries.summary: Webhook: validate client_reference_id is a real WP user before treating it as one
entries.notes: Vendor/sponsor checkouts use post IDs in client_reference_id. get_userdata() check prevents misidentification.

entries.summary: Member table: gate all_paid/new_paid/cards_not_sent views on stripe_subscription_id
entries.notes: Added EXISTS subquery for stripe_subscription_id to Part 1 UWP query for affected views. Filters out users erroneously tagged via old bug without needing a DB cleanup.

entries.summary: Member table Part 3 fallback: require stripe_subscription_id to prevent false positives
entries.notes: Part 3 (_uwp_register_form_id=1 fallback) now requires stripe_subscription_id. Prevents general form-1 registrants from appearing as OHA Members.

entries.summary: SWPM level no longer set for non-subscription Stripe checkouts (shirt/booth payments)
entries.notes: oha_sm_save_from_checkout_session in oha-stripe-minimal.lib.php was calling oha_sm_set_swpm_membership_active for any checkout.session.completed event matching a WP user by email. Added \!empty(session->subscription) guard so SWPM level is only written for membership subscription checkouts. This stopped free members being shown as OHA Paid Members in Board Hub after purchasing shirts or other one-time items.

entries.summary: Add stripe_subscription_status meta written on every paid/free membership state change
entries.notes: userswp_set_paid_member() now writes stripe_subscription_status=active; userswp_set_free_member() writes stripe_subscription_status=cancelled. Both called via oha_bhs_membership_set_paid/free action hooks.

entries.summary: Add Stripe sync migration tool (preview + commit) in membership admin tab
entries.notes: Three REST endpoints: stripe-sync-preview (dry run), stripe-sync-commit (writes meta), verify-member (sets oha_membership_verified=1). Preview classifies members as green/yellow/orange before any writes.

entries.summary: Replace 3-part SWPM/uwp UNION member query with canonical Stripe-based query
entries.notes: New canonical: stripe_subscription_id EXISTS AND stripe_subscription_status=active OR oha_membership_verified=1. SWPM table wp_swpm_members_tbl no longer queried. Listing owner query unchanged (uwp_account_type=listing_owner).

entries.summary: Remove SWPM table writes from webhook handler and Stripe lib
entries.notes: handle_invoice_payment_succeeded() no longer calls oha_sm_set_swpm_membership_active(). apply_free_level() no longer writes to SWPM table. oha_sm_save_from_checkout_session() SWPM call fully removed. oha_sm_sync_to_swpm() stubbed as no-op.

entries.summary: Remove dead SWPM activate call from oha_sm_handle_webhook; replace with canonical oha_bhs_membership_set_paid action
entries.notes: oha_sm_handle_webhook is dead code (REST reg moved to Suite which uses OHA_Webhook_Handler), but cleaned up for safety. The SWPM call at the old invoice.payment_succeeded case now fires the correct action hook instead.

entries.summary: Remove duplicate OHA_Stripe_Webhook_Log call in is_duplicate branch of webhook handler
entries.notes: Second log_event duplicate call (lines 145-147) was a copy-paste artifact. First call at line 138-140 is sufficient.

entries.summary: Delete three .off disabled-file stubs (class-oha-members-table, boardhub-admin, oha-vendor-2026)
entries.notes: .off files are not loaded by WordPress but create maintenance confusion. All three files were replaced by active .php counterparts.

entries.summary: Add admin notice when webhook processing throws an exception (HTTP 500 response)
entries.notes: Stores oha_webhook_failure_alert transient (7 day TTL) on catch. admin_notices() reads and clears it on next admin page load, showing event ID, type, error, and timestamp.

entries.summary: Removed uwp_account_type from all write paths - it was never a real UsersWP field
entries.notes: uwp_account_type is not a real UsersWP field. Real fields are _uwp_register_form_id and WP role. Removed from userswp_set_paid_member, userswp_set_free_member, and oha-stripe-minimal.lib.php.

entries.summary: Listing owner query now uses _uwp_register_form_id=4 instead of uwp_account_type
entries.notes: class-oha-members-table.php get_listing_owner_members INNER JOIN corrected. fetch_members_legacy_raw Part 2 also corrected.

entries.summary: Manual Stripe invoice now triggers membership upgrade via Path B in webhook handler
entries.notes: If invoice->subscription is empty, Path B checks membership product IDs, matches user by stripe_customer_id or email, saves address, sets oha_membership_verified=1, fires oha_bhs_membership_set_paid. Requires membership_product_ids configured in Stripe Settings.

entries.summary: Removed dead oha_sm_handle_webhook function body - REST route already moved to Suite
entries.notes: oha_sm_verify_sig kept - actively called by class-oha-webhook-handler.php. Active endpoint /wp-json/oha/v1/stripe-webhook remains untouched.

entries.summary: Removed legacy unmatched payment system functions and auto-match hooks
entries.notes: Removed store, get, auto_match, manual_match, create_user_from_invoice functions. Removed wp_login, user_register, and profile_update hooks that called auto_match.

entries.summary: Admin notice when trial_end_iso annual renewal date is in the past
entries.notes: Shows on Board Hub admin pages. Warns that new Join OHA checkouts will be blocked until the date is updated to a future UTC timestamp.

entries.summary: Admin notice when membership_product_ids is empty in Stripe Settings
entries.notes: Shows on Board Hub admin pages. Warns that manual Stripe invoice Path B cannot fire until at least one Stripe Product ID is configured.

entries.summary: Preview endpoint now captures and displays Stripe API error message when pages fetched is 0
entries.notes: stripe_error field added to preview REST response and shown in red in the admin UI summary line. Helps diagnose no_key, network errors, or invalid API key issues.

entries.summary: Membership query simplified to _uwp_register_form_id = 1 as sole canonical paid member signal
entries.notes: Replaces stripe_subscription_status/stripe_subscription_id/oha_membership_verified conditions that were never reliably written. All 51 current members already have this key. New and cancelled members written/cleared by userswp_set_paid_member and userswp_set_free_member.

entries.summary: Removed stripe_subscription_status writes from set_paid and set_free member functions
entries.notes: stripe_subscription_status was added in v2.4.0 but was never populated on existing members and caused query confusion. Removed from userswp_set_paid_member and userswp_set_free_member.

entries.summary: Removed stripe_subscription_id write from Stripe sync commit
entries.notes: stripe_subscription_id was never reliably written to user meta at scale. Sync now writes stripe_customer_id and _uwp_register_form_id only via userswp_set_paid_member.

entries.summary: Added user ID search to membership tab - numeric search matches exact user ID
entries.notes: When search string is a plain integer, query also checks u.ID = value. Useful for card lookup workflows where staff know the member card user ID.

entries.summary: Added Membership Health panel to admin backend membership tab
entries.notes: Shows 4 summary counts: total paid, new this month, no Stripe link, needs attention. Needs Attention table lists users with membership_trial_end but without _uwp_register_form_id=1 - i.e. completed checkout but webhook did not promote them. Each row has a Grant Access button with confirm dialog.

entries.summary: Added grant-access REST endpoint oha/v1/membership/grant-access
entries.notes: Calls userswp_set_paid_member for the given user_id. Requires manage_options. Used by the Needs Attention table Grant Access button in the admin Membership Health panel.

entries.summary: Member queries now use strict AND conditions: form_id + WP role required for all member types
entries.notes: OHA member: form_id=1 AND subscriber role. Basic: form_id=4 AND listing_owner role. Board: form_id=2 AND oha_board role. This eliminates false positives from default form_id values.

entries.summary: Added Board Members view to membership tab filtering by form_id=2 and oha_board role
entries.notes: New get_board_members() function. Accessible via board view in the dropdown.

entries.summary: Added All Users view to membership tab returning every WP user with inferred account type
entries.notes: New get_all_users() function. Infers type from form_id + capabilities. Users not matching any known type show as Other.

entries.summary: Renamed Listing Owner label to Basic Member in membership table badges
entries.notes: Consistent with user-facing terminology. Label change only, no data changes.

entries.summary: Reordered and renamed membership tab view dropdown options for clearer UI
entries.notes: Views now ordered: OHA Members, New OHA Members, Basic Members, New Basic Members, Board Members, Cards Not Sent, All Users.

entries.summary: Replaced usermeta JOINs with correlated LIMIT 1 subqueries to prevent duplicate rows in member table
entries.notes: LEFT JOIN and INNER JOIN on wp_usermeta caused row multiplication when users had multiple rows for the same meta key (e.g. oha_paid_member_since). All four query functions updated: get_canonical_paid_members, get_listing_owner_members, get_board_members, get_all_users. Also fixed new_paid WHERE clause that referenced paid.meta_value alias after JOIN removal.

entries.summary: Fixed duplicate rows in frontend shortcode member list by replacing usermeta JOINs with LIMIT 1 subqueries
entries.notes: fetch_members_legacy_raw() in oha-board-hub.lib.php had the same LEFT JOIN / INNER JOIN row-multiplication bug as the admin table. Part 2 uwp query: removed INNER JOIN on form_id + LEFT JOINs on first_name/last_name/oha_paid_member_since; replaced with EXISTS + correlated subqueries. Part 3 fallback query: same fix. Also changed um_form.meta_value filter condition to EXISTS.

entries.summary: Fixed duplicate rows in frontend shortcode member list by replacing usermeta JOINs with LIMIT 1 subqueries
entries.notes: fetch_members_legacy_raw() in oha-board-hub.lib.php had the same LEFT JOIN / INNER JOIN row-multiplication bug as the admin table. Part 2 uwp query: removed INNER JOIN on form_id + LEFT JOINs on first_name/last_name/oha_paid_member_since, replaced with EXISTS + correlated subqueries. Part 3 fallback query: same fix. Also changed um_form.meta_value filter condition to EXISTS.

entries.summary: Added numeric user ID exact-match search to frontend shortcode member list
entries.notes: fetch_members_legacy_raw() Part 2 and Part 3 search conditions now check ctype_digit() and add u.ID = %d condition when a numeric query is entered, matching admin table behavior added in v2.6.0.

entries.summary: Fixed cards_not_sent filter to check both usermeta and wp_oha_card_status table, eliminating false positives
entries.notes: SQL now uses two NOT EXISTS subqueries. Members with sent=1 in either location are correctly excluded from the not-sent view.

entries.summary: Added REST endpoint sync-card-status for bidirectional sync of card-sent data between usermeta and card table
entries.notes: Pass 1: usermeta -> card table. Pass 2: card table -> usermeta (WP user IDs only, skips legacy SWPM-only IDs). Endpoint: POST oha/v1/membership/sync-card-status.

entries.summary: Added Card Status Sync section to Membership Health admin panel with record counts and sync button
entries.notes: Shows live count of usermeta and card table sent records before sync. Displays meta_to_table and table_to_meta counts after sync completes.

entries.summary: Fixed inflated member counts by gating OHA Member and Basic Member queries on oha_member_id usermeta
entries.notes: oha_member_id was migrated to usermeta 2026-05-20 for all 269 known members. Gate ensures only real members appear in filtered views, not all users with matching role/form_id.

entries.summary: ID column now shows permanent OHA member card number (oha_member_id) instead of WP user ID
entries.notes: All 4 query functions now SELECT oha_member_id subquery and include it in returned member array. CSV export also uses oha_member_id.

entries.summary: Numeric search now matches against oha_member_id card number in all member views
entries.notes: Searching for a number (e.g. 5) now finds the member with card #5, not WP user ID 5. Updated in all 4 query functions.

entries.summary: Migrated OHA member IDs from SWPM to oha_member_id usermeta for all 269 members
entries.notes: SWPM plugin removed; IDs 1-192 preserved from physical cards; IDs 284-370 assigned to new members by reg date; Florence Gepperth WP 169 mapped to card 165 (email mismatch). Migration SQL in session transcript.

entries.summary: Canonical member query gates on oha_member_id EXISTS, fixing inflated counts seen in v2.7.0
entries.notes: v2.7.0 showed All(446)/OHA(158)/Basic(283); correct baseline is All(208)/OHA(91)/Basic(112). Root cause was form_id=1 false positives. oha_member_id gate caps results to known members only.

entries.summary: Member table ID column displays permanent OHA card number from oha_member_id usermeta
entries.notes: Falls back to WP user_id or SM:{swpm_id} if oha_member_id not set. Search box placeholder updated to include Member ID.

entries.summary: Default Membership tab view changed to Create Membership Cards (cards not yet sent)
entries.notes: Board member workflow: load tab -> see members needing cards -> send card -> mark sent. Renamed dropdown option from Cards Not Sent to Create Membership Cards.

entries.summary: CSV export now correctly exports the current filtered view, not the default view
entries.notes: Hidden inputs capture current GET view/search params so POST handler exports matching records. Default fallback also updated to cards_not_sent.

entries.summary: Frontend [oha_board_hub] shortcode Members tab now defaults to OHA Members / Create Membership Cards view
entries.notes: Default lvl changed from all to oha; default card filter changed from any to not; Not Sent button label renamed to Create Membership Cards. Matches admin panel default behavior.

entries.summary: Frontend CSV export now applies card filter; was exporting all members regardless of Not Sent selection
entries.notes: export_members_csv() handler now reads card GET param and applies same PHP filter as render_members_tab(). Default card fallback is not to match tab default.

entries.summary: Fixed card status lookup in frontend shortcode: SWPM member_id did not match WP user_id in card table
entries.notes: get_card_status() now accepts optional wp_user_id param and checks both ids against card table, options store, and usermeta. Admin panel marks cards against WP user_id; SWPM table uses SWPM member_id. Both lookups now attempted. All three call sites updated (tab filter, table display, CSV export).

entries.summary: Members tab now defaults to All Time range so card-making view shows all members needing cards
entries.notes: Range default changed from 30d to all when tab=members. Previously the 30d default combined with card=not produced zero results on initial load. Export handler range default also updated to all. Overview tab unaffected -- it uses its own hardcoded date logic.

entries.summary: Members tab initial load shows last 30 days new/upgraded OHA members not yet sent a card
entries.notes: Range default reverted to 30d. subscription_starts already prefers oha_paid_member_since over user_registered so upgraded members are included. Create Membership Cards button now always hard-resets to lvl=oha range=30d card=not q= regardless of current state -- acts as a bookmark back to the baseline card-making view.

entries.summary: Create Membership Cards view now uses All Time range so backlog members with corrupted paid dates are not filtered out
entries.notes: oha_paid_member_since was written as the Stripe Sync run date for legacy members rather than actual payment date. A 30d filter based on that date hid members like Tyler Bell (paid Sept 2025, date stored as April 14 2026). Default and CMC button now use range=all so the filter is purely card_not_sent. The 30d/90d/ytd range buttons are still available for narrowing. Export default also updated to all.

entries.summary: Frontend member table now shows oha_member_id card number instead of WP user ID
entries.notes: fetch_members_legacy_raw() now fetches oha_member_id from usermeta in the SQL query. render_members_table() displays oha_member_id when available, falls back to WP user_id. Previously WP user_id (e.g. 87) was shown instead of card number (e.g. 83), causing mismatch with admin panel.

entries.summary: Removed hardcoded convention_2026 vendor tab hooks and the_content injection from vendor integration lib

entries.notes: Old hooks: oha_board_hub_render_tab_convention_2026 action and the_content filter. Replace by adding [oha_vendor_boardhub] as a custom tab in Board Hub Settings > Tab Management.

entries.summary: Fixed custom tab slug revert bug where edited slug reverted to auto-generated key on save
entries.notes: Added sanitize callback to register_setting that re-keys tab_management array entries when slug value differs from array key. Applies only to type=custom tabs.

entries.summary: Auto-assign WP user ID as oha_member_id on membership activation if not already set
entries.notes: Called from userswp_set_paid_member() in oha-board-hub-suite.php. Uses INSERT-or-skip logic: get_user_meta check before update_user_meta, so existing values are never overwritten. Going forward all new members get their WP user ID as permanent card number.

entries.summary: Editable card number field in frontend member table with database warning
entries.notes: Pencil icon on ID column opens inline input. Save triggers confirm dialog warning before writing to DB. AJAX handler action_oha_set_member_id() in oha-board-hub.lib.php writes oha_member_id usermeta. Nonce scoped to wp_user_id.

entries.summary: Replace pencil button on ID column with clickable dotted-underline number
entries.notes: Removed separate button element that inherited large theme styles. oha-mid-display span is now the click target with cursor:pointer and text-decoration:underline dotted. JS updated to match.

entries.summary: Sort member table by subscription_starts DESC so upgraded listing owners appear newest first
entries.notes: usort added at end of fetch_members_legacy_raw(); sorts by oha_paid_member_since (stored as subscription_starts) rather than user_registered from DB ORDER BY

entries.summary: Added Convention Financials module: year-over-year budget tracking with 22 pre-seeded categories
entries.notes: Two-table schema: wp_oha_budget_categories (master list) + wp_oha_budget_entries (per year). Categories: income, expense, sponsorship, charity types. Frontend tab on Board Hub shortcode. CSV export on WP admin page only. Restricted to oha_board role + admins.

entries.summary: Replaced hardcoded finance tab stub with OHA_Financials class delegation
entries.notes: Old render_finance_tab() had hardcoded estimated values and emojis. Now delegates entirely to OHA_Financials::render_tab().

entries.summary: Fixed duplicate budget categories seeded by race condition on first page load
entries.notes: Same root cause as survey-hub vendor question dedup (v1.3.1): concurrent requests both passed COUNT > 0 guard before either committed. Fix: dedup_categories() self-join DELETE keeps lowest id per (name, type). Runs once via oha_fin_cat_dedup_done option flag.

entries.summary: Convention tab label and heading now read from oha_vhcpt_convention_name option instead of hardcoded 2026
entries.notes: Affects oha-board-hub.lib.php (tab title, overview card, fallback message) and class-oha-admin-page.php (WP admin tab label and heading). Falls back to Convention + active year if option is empty.

entries.summary: Admin vendor tab stats now filter by active convention year instead of all-time totals
entries.notes: All 5 queries in render_vendor_tab() now JOIN on _convention_year = oha_vhcpt_active_year. Previously showed cumulative counts across all years.

entries.summary: Overview tab vendor stat cards now filter by active convention year only
entries.notes: All 6 queries in render_overview_tab() (total, paid, pending, booths, recent, recent_payments) now JOIN on _convention_year = oha_vhcpt_active_year. Previously showed all-time totals across every year.

entries.summary: Fix zero-members bug on first visit: card filter closure read $_GET[card] directly, null vs not was always false
entries.notes: Closure now uses use(). Affected render_members_tab() in oha-board-hub.lib.php line ~1381.

entries.summary: Rework members tab filter UI: new Level/Range buttons, standalone Create Membership Cards button, clear active states
entries.notes: All new styles use .oha-members-* CSS prefix. Level buttons reset range to all. CMC button uses green palette11. Card filter row removed.

entries.summary: Members tab default view changed to all levels, all time -- full member list on first visit
entries.notes: lvl default changed from oha to all. card default changed from not to any. Invalid lvl fallback also changed to all.

entries.summary: Export CSV now uses oha_member_id as card_number column and includes date-stamped filename
entries.notes: Export handler defaults updated to match new tab defaults (lvl=all, card=any).

entries.summary: Members tab search replaced with client-side live search; filters no longer preserve search term
entries.notes: Server-side q param removed from filter button URLs and SQL calls. Plain input with JS input listener filters tbody rows instantly. oha-members-main-table ID scopes search away from Stripe section table below.

entries.summary: Export CSV button hides automatically when live search is active
entries.notes: exportWrap visibility toggled in the same input listener as live search. Reappears when search box is cleared. Prevents exporting a set that does not match what is visible on screen.

entries.summary: Card number edits now append audit history to oha_member_id_history usermeta
entries.notes: action_oha_set_member_id reads old value then appends {old, new, changed_by, ts} to serialized history array before overwriting. History only created on users whose card number has been changed. Avoids card events table due to SWPM member_id key conflict.

entries.summary: CSV import panel on haunt discounts admin page with fuzzy name matching and confidence preview
entries.notes: REST routes oha/v1/haunt-discounts/preview-import and confirm-import. similar_text() scoring with color-coded preview table (green >=80%, yellow >=55%, red <55%). Editable rows before confirm.

entries.summary: Change history sub-rows in haunt discounts admin table with toggle button
entries.notes: _oha_disc_history meta key stores up to 10 entries (date, user, status, rate, message, source). History button reveals hidden sub-row inline. Read-only display.

entries.summary: Promo Code and Private Link columns added to haunt discounts admin table
entries.notes: New meta keys _oha_disc_promo_code and _oha_disc_private_link. Both inline-editable via existing single-row REST endpoint. Added to allowlist in switch-case. History colspan updated from 10 to 12.

entries.summary: Replace subscription_data trial_end with billing_cycle_anchor + proration_behavior=none
entries.notes: Removes Stripe Checkout  X days free language. Billing behavior unchanged:  today, /year from Jan 1 2027. Existing subscriptions unaffected. OHA_BHS_VERSION also corrected from stale 2.13.0 to match header.

entries.summary: Move  card fee to subscription_data add_invoice_items to fix proration_behavior=none Stripe error
entries.notes: Stripe blocks proration_behavior=none when one-time prices exist in line_items. Moving price_signup_20 to add_invoice_items resolves this.  still charged immediately at checkout on the first subscription invoice. billing_cycle_anchor approach retained.

entries.summary: Revert checkout to trial_end; update shortcode copy to explain Stripe free-trial language to members
entries.notes: billing_cycle_anchor with proration_behavior=none is blocked by Stripe when one-time prices exist. add_invoice_items is not supported in Checkout Session API. trial_end is the only working approach. Shortcode now shows a note warning members that the Stripe checkout page will say X days free and explains it is not a free trial.
